name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a complete QAOA MaxCut solver in Qiskit
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a complete QAOA MaxCut solver in Qiskit (depth p=1) for edges [(0, 2), (1, 2), (1, 3), (2, 3)], including manual cost/mixer construction, classical optimization, and sampling of the final state. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
